# Abdullah Bin Asim — Full Stack Developer & AI Builder

AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional and Claude Certified Architect – Foundations. 3+ years experience, 25+ projects shipped. Builds fast, scalable web apps with React, Next.js, Node.js, and AI-powered automation.
